### Why IT Companies Face the Worst Background Verification Problem in India


If you are hiring developers in India in 2026, you are operating in the highest-fraud-risk hiring environment of any sector in the country. The data is unambiguous.


According to[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files H2 2025](https://cxotoday.com/media-coverage/1-in-5-it-resumes-misrepresented-telecom-reports-11-hiring-discrepancies/) (based on Oct 2024–Mar 2025 verification data), the **IT/ITES sector has a 9.46% overall discrepancy rate** — more than double the national average. Here is the breakdown:


IT/ITES Fraud Type Rate What It Means


**Overall discrepancy rate** 9.46% Nearly 1 in 10 IT candidates has something wrong in their background


**Misrepresented profiles** 18.8% Nearly 1 in 5 IT resumes contains inflated titles, exaggerated tenures, unverifiable employers, or false notice periods


**Employment discrepancies** 7% Fake employers, inflated tenure, fabricated roles


**Moonlighting (dual employment)** 4.99% 1 in 20 IT professionals working two full-time jobs simultaneously


**Education discrepancies** 4.84% Unverifiable institutions, degrees that don’t match claimed courses


**Address discrepancies** 10.11% Unverifiable addresses provided during onboarding


An[EY India study](https://www.ey.com/en_in/newsroom/2025/05/employment-fraud-on-the-rise-ey-study-calls-for-tech-enabled-vigilance-in-hiring-amidst-rising-risks-across-sectors) based on 1 million+ pre-employment screenings adds even more alarming IT-specific data:


- **45% of IT candidates were found moonlighting** — caught through dual-employment tools or active GST registrations linked to their PAN
- **32% submitted documents from fake employers** — companies that did not exist or whose employers denied issuing documents
- **85% of discrepant IT profiles were flagged by employment checks** — making employment verification the single most critical check for IT hiring
- **79% of offenders were experienced workers** — not freshers, but mid-career professionals with years in the workforce


### Why Standard BGV Fails for IT Developer Hiring


Traditional background verification was designed for industries where employees sit in one office and work for one employer. IT developers in 2026 work remotely, freelance on the side, switch jobs every 12–18 months, and often have experience at startups that may no longer exist. This creates specific verification challenges:


Challenge Why It’s Worse for IT What IT Companies Need


**Moonlighting** Remote work makes dual employment invisible; 45% rate (EY) EPFO check showing overlapping employer dates


**Fake employers** 32% of discrepant IT profiles cite non-existent companies (EY) Government employment records, not just reference calls


**Inflated tenure** Short stints are common; candidates round up to look stable EPFO records with exact joining/exit dates


**Fabricated experience** Defunct startups can’t be called to verify EPFO/PF contribution records as proof of employment


**Education fraud** 4.84% rate; unaccredited online degrees increasingly common DigiLocker or institutional verification


**Fast hiring cycles** Developer offers accepted/rejected within 3–5 days Verification must complete in minutes, not weeks

### 3. How can IT companies detect developer moonlighting?


The most reliable method is the **UAN/EPFO past employment history check** . When a developer works for two companies simultaneously, both employers contribute to their Provident Fund, creating overlapping employment records. SalaryBox Verify pulls these EPFO records in minutes, making overlapping dates immediately visible. AuthBridge also offers dual-employment detection through database analytics, though it takes 2–7 days.


### 4. Why is EPFO the most important check for IT hiring?


According to EY’s data, **85% of discrepant IT profiles are flagged by employment checks** . The EPFO record is the single most reliable employment verification source because: (a) it shows actual employers (not what the candidate wrote), (b) it shows exact joining/exit dates (not inflated), (c) it reveals salary brackets (not fabricated), and (d) it exposes overlapping employment (moonlighting). SalaryBox Verify queries this at Rs. 499 in minutes.
